style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=15;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=8;fontSize=12;" value="<b>Business Rules</b><br><br>• A user can write only one review per course.<br>• Only verified, active students can write reviews, file reports, or submit catalog requests.<br>• Each review is about exactly one course and the professor who taught it.<br>• Retired courses and professors cannot receive new reviews; existing reviews remain.<br>• Courses and professors are retired, never deleted.<br>• Only admins manage the catalog, resolve reports, and ban users.<br>• Deleting an account or banning a user deletes all of their reviews.<br>• Banned users cannot log in or sign up again with the same email.<br>• Reviews are shown publicly as from a "Verified RIT student."<br>• Average scores for courses and professors are calculated from their reviews.<br>• All admin actions (removals, dismissals, bans) are recorded for accountability." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="300" x="790" y="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

Business Rules
• A user can write only one review per course.
• Only verified, active students can write reviews, file reports, or submit catalog requests.
• Each review is about exactly one course and the professor who taught it.
• Retired courses and professors cannot receive new reviews; existing reviews remain.
• Courses and professors are retired, never deleted.
• Only admins manage the catalog, resolve reports, and ban users.
• Deleting an account or banning a user deletes all of their reviews.
• Banned users cannot log in or sign up again with the same email.
• Reviews are shown publicly as from a "Verified RIT student."
• Average scores for courses and professors are calculated from their reviews.
• All admin actions (removals, dismissals, bans) are recorded for accountability.
